propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are incorrectly located in fsck_repair.py despite having no repair-related logic, creating an inverted dependency where seven production modules import from the repair module for non-repair functionality.
Move the three filesystem primitives from src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py to src/rebar/_store/gitutil.py to eliminate the architectural inversion and place them in a stdlib-only leaf module.

Maintain backward compatibility by keeping module-level re-imports of all three primitives in fsck_repair.py and re-exports in fsck.py so that existing test patches binding these as module attributes continue to work without test file changes.
Direct consumers (compact.py, bridge_repair.py, tracker_maintenance.py) must import the primitives directly from gitutil rather than from fsck_repair to eliminate the inverted dependency.
Verify that gitutil remains a stdlib-only leaf with no module-level rebar imports and that no circular dependencies are introduced by the move.
